---
title: "Wellbeing report"
format: html
params:
  programme: "Master's"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)

# The solutions folder is one level below the data
students  <- read.csv("../students.csv")
semesters <- read.csv("../semesters.csv")

programme_semesters <- semesters |>
  left_join(students, join_by(student_id)) |>
  filter(programme == params$programme)

first_sleep <- programme_semesters |>
  filter(semester == 1) |>
  pull(sleep_hours) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)
```

This report describes the `r n_distinct(programme_semesters$student_id)` students
of the `r params$programme` programme. In their first semester, they slept
`r sprintf("%.1f", first_sleep)` hours a night on average.

```{r}
programme_semesters |>
  summarise(Students = n_distinct(student_id),
            Wellbeing = mean(wellbeing, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = semester) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1, col.names = c("Semester", "Students", "Average wellbeing"))
```
